failureAnalysis.reasoning: The test failed with an 'Invalid session token' error while attempting to log in with valid credentials. Although a TimeoutException was thrown, it was a secondary consequence of the automation script waiting for a redirection to '/dashboard' that never occurred because the application failed to authenticate the session. This points directly to a functional defect in the application's authentication or token generation mechanism.

defectReport.title: User login fails with valid credentials due to 'Invalid session token' error
defectReport.description: During the execution of the automated login test with valid credentials, the application failed to redirect the user to the dashboard. The page remained on the login screen, and an 'Invalid session token' error was encountered, causing the automation script to time out waiting for the '/dashboard' redirection.
stepsToReproduce: Observe the page URL and application behavior.
defectReport.expectedResult: The user should be successfully authenticated and redirected to the '/dashboard' page.
defectReport.actualResult: The page remains on '/login' and an 'Invalid session token' error is encountered, preventing redirection.
defectReport.possibleRootCause: The authentication service or backend API failed to generate a valid session token, or rejected the newly generated token during the login handshake, preventing the application from completing the redirection flow.
defectReport.supportingEvidence: Error: Invalid session token. Exception: TimeoutException. Stack Trace: LoginPage.java:42, LoginTest.java:18.
defectReport.recommendation: Verify the token generation and validation logic in the authentication service. Check backend logs for the specific timestamp of the test run to identify why the session token was flagged as invalid.
